title: Image Studio
subtitle: Slide visuals · Research figures · General art
optimizeHint: Polish and enrich your wording with AI, without adding new constraints
finalPromptEmpty: Write a scene description to compose the final prompt
finalPromptHint: Purpose, style, palette and text space are composed automatically
providerVolcengineDesc: Doubao image creation models with text-to-image, image-to-image and sequential sets
providerQwenDesc: Qwen image generation and editing models, OpenAI-compatible API
providerOpenaiDesc: GPT Image models with native 16:9, 4K output and multilingual text rendering
referencesHint: Drag, paste or click to upload, up to {{count}}
referenceNotSupported: This model does not accept reference images
textSpaceHint: Reserve a clean area for a title or caption
noTextHint: Use only for drafts you'll re-typeset later; keep off for finished figures with short labels
titleEnabledHint: The model draws the text directly; expect occasional typos or layout drift
titlePlaceholder: Title, e.g. Research background and questions
titleEnabledWarn: Text is rendered by the model and may contain typos. Turn it off if accuracy matters.
countHint: Generate several at once to pick the best
groupGenerationHint: Let the model produce a related set of images, up to {{count}}
transparentBgHint: PNG with alpha, ready to layer onto slides or papers
watermarkHint: Adds an AI-generated mark at the bottom-right corner
promptEnhanceHint: Let the model expand and refine your prompt
negativePromptPlaceholder: Describe what to avoid, e.g. blurry, text, watermark
noKeyDesc: Add a Volcengine Ark, Alibaba Cloud Bailian or OpenAI API key to start generating.
pptHint: Use 16:9 with minimal density and right-side space, then add your title in PowerPoint
submitHint: Results are saved to your local library automatically
emptyDesc: Pick a purpose on the left and describe the scene — generated images will appear here.
deleteDesc: It will be removed from the library and the file moved to trash.
noResultsDesc: Try another keyword or clear the filters
settingsGroupOutputDesc: Purpose, provider and size used for new work
settingsGroupOptionsDesc: Extras enabled by default for each run
settingsGroupModelsDesc: Models used for prompt optimization and the employee image tool
settingsGroupStorageDesc: Download folder and work data directory
settingsProviderHint: Each provider keeps its own API key and endpoint
apiKeyKeep: Saved — leave empty to keep it
apiKeyHint: Encrypted with the system keychain and stored locally. Never sent anywhere else.
qwenBaseUrlHint: Use the DashScope native URL (/api/v1, the generation endpoint is appended automatically) or the OpenAI-compatible URL (/compatible-mode/v1). A workspace domain such as https://{WorkspaceId}.cn-beijing.maas.aliyuncs.com also works as-is.
modelPlaceholder: Select or enter a model ID
testInvalidKey: Invalid API key or permission denied
optimizeModelHint: The Optimize button rewrites prompts with this model. Leave empty to use the host default model.
toolModelHint: Provider and model used by the agent image tool. Leave empty to follow the default provider and its default model.
downloadDirHint: Results always live in the library; Download copies them to this folder. Empty uses your Pictures folder.
dataDirHint: Originals and thumbnails live here and survive plugin removal.
aboutDesc: Image Studio is built for slide visuals, research figures, architecture and flow diagrams: nine purpose presets (ratio, text space, palette, optional no-text drafts), AI prompt optimization that yields complete labeled figures by default, three providers — Volcengine Seedream, Qwen Image and OpenAI GPT Image — and a fully local library.
usageHint: Create an API key in the provider console and paste it above. Keys and endpoints must belong to the same region.

ppt-slide.name: Slide visual
ppt-slide.placeholder: Describe what this slide explains, e.g. a three-stage growth path from data capture to intelligent decisions

ppt-cover.name: Slide cover
ppt-cover.placeholder: Describe the cover theme, e.g. 2026 product strategy, abstract geometry and light beams

sci-schematic.name: Scientific schematic
sci-schematic.placeholder: Describe the mechanism or workflow, e.g. autophagy regulation pathway with three key nodes and signal arrows

paper-figure.name: Paper figure
paper-figure.placeholder: Describe the paper's core finding, e.g. how a multimodal model fuses visual and textual representations

chart.name: Data chart
chart.placeholder: Describe the chart, e.g. five-year revenue growth grouped by quarter

infographic.name: Infographic
infographic.placeholder: Describe the structure, e.g. a four-step user growth funnel with one icon per step

architecture.name: Architecture diagram
architecture.placeholder: Describe the system structure, e.g. a four-layer architecture of frontend, gateway, microservices and data, connected by arrows

flowchart.name: Flowchart
flowchart.placeholder: Describe the process, e.g. a five-step flow from requirement to release with an approval branch

poster.name: Academic poster
poster.placeholder: Describe the poster theme, e.g. tumour immunotherapy research, conference poster background

free.name: Free creation
free.desc: No scene constraints · follow the prompt
free.placeholder: Describe the image you want, e.g. a rainy Tokyo street at night, neon reflections on wet pavement, cinematic

inspirations.food: Japanese cuisine close-up, wooden table, warm side light
